content:
While CarPlay supports hundreds of apps, Apple Weather isn't one of them. The good news is that, starting today, The Weather Channel's Storm Radar iPhone app officially supports CarPlay.

Storm Radar is one of a growing number of weather apps for CarPlay.

The Weather Channel has been working throughout this year to make Storm Radar a top-tier app on Apple platforms.

The iPhone and iPad versions added AI-powered forecasting features earlier, followed by an Apple Watch version.

Today's new update goes even further, adding a dedicated CarPlay app. Here's what the app looks like:

The CarPlay version of Storm Radar includes a map of your location, with the ability to switch between satellite and standard map backgrounds. Data layers include radar, clouds, and precipitation.

Navigation is also one of the core features of the CarPlay app. Storm Radar shows your current weather conditions, along with the estimated time of arrival and the forecasted weather at your destination.

The Weather Channel added that CarPlay support includes "automatic rerouting along the road, and weather alerts along the route that update as you drive."

Today's Storm Radar app update also includes new home screen widgets, a redesigned Apple Watch app, and more. You can see the full update notes for version 4.0.19 on the App Store.
